materials_exhausted.note: Primary XML/PDF, OA package NXML/PDF, extracted supplement PDF text, figure captions, and linked database snapshots were reopened. Landing .bin files are HTML pages, but the OA package supplied the actionable supplementary PDF text.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay/literature rows are source-verified against article metadata, Figure 5 identity evidence, Tables 2/3, and Figure 9. Six CAMP/dbAMP aggregate rows are retained as source_conflict cautions because packet sequence rows for those non-DBAASP identifiers are absent.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Tables 2/3 were manually parsed into row-level LC outcomes for all four peptides across Gram-positive and Gram-negative targets, retaining numeric µM values, NA no-activity calls, and ND not-determined calls. Figure 9 supports qualitative mouse erythrocyte non-toxicity up to 25 µM.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct membrane permeability/SEM evidence is accepted as membrane-disruption support; receptor co-evolution is kept as inferred evolutionary mechanism rather than direct receptor binding.
